title: Stardew Valley Farm Planner & Layout Editor
description: Design a Stardew Valley farm layout with buildings, paths and sprinklers. Check coverage, arrange linked interiors and export a practice plan.
guideText: Choose one of eight original landscape templates or import a private terrain package. Place objects, inspect water coverage and arrange linked building interiors. Export JSON to retain editable data; PNG is a visual snapshot. Built-in landscapes are not extracted game maps.
intro: Design a farm layout on an illustrative grid, measure coverage, and export a plan.

title: Stardew Valley Community Center Bundle Tracker
description: Track Stardew Valley Community Center bundles by room, season, quantity and quality. Open the private workspace to read supported bundle requirements from a save.
guideText: Track standard donations by room, season, quantity and quality. If your game uses a different set of bundles, check the requirements from your main save in the private workspace or enter them manually.

title: Stardew Valley Museum Collection & Donation Tracker
description: Find all 95 Stardew Valley museum artifacts and minerals. Check acquisition hints, track donations and review museum reward milestones.
guideText: Discovery is not donation. Use acquisition filters and reward milestones, then arrange items on an original practice display grid. This is not the exact in-game museum floor plan.

title: Stardew Valley Geode Predictor for PC 1.6.15
description: Preview the next 20 Clint geode openings for Stardew Valley PC 1.6.15. The private tool can compare the experimental result with your recorded openings.
secondaryKeywords: stardew valley does luck affect geodes
guideText: Select a container and enter how many openings the example farmer has completed. Review the next 20 candidate slots, or open the private workspace to enter your own fields locally. Independent game verification is pending.

title: Stardew Valley Save Tracker & Collection Progress
description: Review Stardew Valley collection progress and inspect supported save fields locally in the private workspace. Find the next fish, recipes or shipments to check.
secondaryKeywords: how many steps have i taken stardew
stardew how many steps have you taken
guideTitle: Inspect a save without uploading it
guideText: The separate private workspace reads selected main-player XML fields, merges recognized collection observations in one local transaction and allows explicit XP and earnings prefill. Missing values remain unknown; this is not a complete game save reconstruction.

title: Stardew Valley Crop Calculator: Profit & Planting
description: Use the Stardew Valley crop calculator to compare seed costs, harvest dates, crop profit and processing capacity by season, planting day and budget.
guideText: Choose a planting day, tiles and planting budget. Compare guaranteed yields and raw sales, optionally test two seasons or a fixed fertilizer and quality scenario, then check cash and machine capacity in the economy tool.

title: Stardew Valley Fair Calculator: Grange Display
description: Calculate a Stardew Valley Fair grange display score or compare nine-item combinations using the items, qualities and quantities you have.
guideText: Enter actual sale values, quality and Fair categories, or supply a quantity-limited list of available candidates to optimize the nine-slot display. The score separates quantity, variety and item points. Do not apply sale-value multipliers twice.

title: Stardew Valley Fish Collection & Fishing Checklist
description: Find fish for the Stardew Valley collection by season, location, time and weather. Track 72 collection entries and export missing fish.
guideText: Filter recorded main-route season, location, weather, time and acquisition method. Missing conditions remain unspecified, not guaranteed. Record actual catches; challenge-only legendary variants are excluded.

title: Stardew Valley Perfection Checklist & 100% Tracker
description: Estimate Stardew Valley perfection from weighted goals and known collection progress. See the current range, missing milestones and the cost of waivers.
guideText: Enter observed category counts to distinguish unknown progress from a confirmed zero. The private workspace also uses local collection counts and available save observations for the weighted estimate.

title: Stardew Valley Crafting Recipes & Materials Checklist
description: Browse 149 Stardew Valley crafting recipes, check selected unlocks, track crafted items and total the materials needed for multiple batches.
guideTitle: Prepare a batch of crafting recipes
guideText: Select recipes and batch quantities, then inspect direct ingredients, stock shortages and estimated costs. Batch outputs may contain multiple items. Intermediate recipes and profession-specific ingredient substitutions are not automatically expanded.

title: Stardew Valley Shipping List & Items Shipped Tracker
description: Check all 154 Stardew Valley shipping collection entries. Search items, review missing shipments and merge recognized save progress in the private workspace.
guideText: Filter the 154 reference entries and mark an item only after shipping it in the game. Finding or owning an item is not the same as shipping it. Export your checklist for later use.

title: Stardew Valley Cooking Recipes & Ingredients Checklist
description: Look up 81 Stardew Valley cooking recipes. Filter selected recipe unlocks, track cooked dishes and combine ingredients for planned batches.
guideText: Select recipes, enter batch quantities, and compare required ingredients against current inventory. Unlock hints identify common learning routes. Unknown prices remain unknown; intermediate dishes are not recursively expanded.

title: Stardew Valley Golden Walnut Locations & Tracker
description: Find Ginger Island Golden Walnut locations by region and landmark. Track 130 walnuts, review task hints and record parrot upgrade spending.
guideTitle: Track lifetime finds separately from spending
guideText: Record repeated drops individually and fixed rewards as complete tasks. The upgrade ledger subtracts purchases from recorded balance, not lifetime collection. Puzzle hints can be revealed when needed.

title: Stardew Valley Farm Types: Map & Tile Comparison
description: Compare all eight Stardew Valley farm types by tillable land, additional buildable tiles and layout features. Open a corresponding practice layout.
guideTitle: Choose a farm for your priorities
guideText: Compare eight farm types by reference area and characteristics. Water, obstacles and sprinkler restrictions affect practical capacity. The original design templates are illustrative, not pixel-accurate game maps.

title: Stardew Valley Grandpa’s Evaluation Calculator
description: Calculate Grandpa’s Evaluation points and candle thresholds. Review earnings, skills, friendship and milestones, with optional private save inputs.
guideText: Enter lifetime earnings, skill levels, friendships and completed milestones. Four candles require at least 12 points in the reference model. Record community center completion and its ceremony separately.

title: Stardew Valley Skills, Professions & XP Tracker
description: Check Stardew Valley skill XP thresholds, profession branches and mastery progress. Load recognized XP in the private workspace or compare levels manually.
guideText: Enter skill experience and mastery points to compare against thresholds. The overnight level-up event determines actual profession rewards. Mastery points are separate from the five base skill experience values.
